title: Ordinary immersion pullback in constant-scalar coordinates
statement: Let i:S -> X be an immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and k any commutative ring in the coefficient universe. Transport fixed-k sheaves on X into modules over the constant k ring sheaf on the pro-etale AsSmall model, using the inverse model equivalence and inverse constant-scalar restriction [def-coef-constant-scalar-restriction]. Composing with ConstantCompletion.pull for sfbImmersionAlgebra i and its constant coefficient isomorphism is naturally isomorphic to sfbFixedResiduePull i k [def-sfb-adic-immersion-residue-comparison-core]. This statement concerns ordinary module sheaves only, with no completed coefficient, ideal, derived complex or Noetherian hypothesis.

proof.text: Define the canonical constant coefficient direct-image map by transposing the whiskered target sheafification unit. Its scalar-normalization equation identifies its adjoint transpose with the specified constantMap of the algebraic inverse image.

Apply the supplied-algebraic-presentation adjunction for the continuous ringed topos. The scalar-normalization equality is precisely its required coefficient compatibility. Identify its sheafified tensor functor with ConstantCompletion.change on objects and maps, obtaining the ordinary module pull/direct-image adjunction.

Under evaluation from the AsSmall model, constant-scalar direct image commutes with the original fixed-k direct image. Its section map is the identity additive map; linearity is the sheafification Hom-equivalence equation stating that each constant a maps to a. The restrictionIso comparison identifies this realization with the specified restriction equivalence.
Compose each ordinary adjunction with the model and scalar equivalences. Conjugate the right-adjoint square to obtain the claimed natural isomorphism of left adjoints.
